item.title: US wholesale inventories rebound strongly in September
item.description: U.S. wholesale inventories rebounded in September amid increases in the stocks of long-lasting manufactured goods, which likely provided a lift to gross domestic product in the third quarter. item.title: African appetite for cement drives 13% jump in shipments
item.description: “Between January and November 2025, cement shipments, including clinker, have jumped 13% y/y, driven by a 39% y/y increase in shipments to Africa’s Atlantic coast. item.description: More than 30 U.S.-sanctioned oil vessels doing business in Venezuela could face punishment by Washington after the Coast Guard seized a supertanker carrying for export, according to shipping data.
